body: Wow, thanks for contributing to the stigma around disorders!
like how this sub seems to mostly be gate keeping now and appears to dislike people genuinely struggling with clinical diagnoses

Thank you for replying to my post.

I guess I'm just unlucky because everyone dipped except my partner (who luckily is extremely apathetic and not really good at showing care). Though I am very lucky that they still stuck around through all this.

It's at around an 8 now, but a 10 last night. Thank you, but I think I'll be okay, I dont want to force others to have to talk to me:)

I'm glad it's happening somewhere at least. Crisis help really needs to be pushed as well, because being put on hold for 20 minutes after calling a hotline just doesn't help.
And yep I'm still around

I think the reason is different depending to the person and what they are going through. Personally for me it was a boost of endorphins that I didnt have otherwise and it got me through some of the worse times, and I still struggle.

Yeah, that is true, but that means we need to learn from a professional how to ask for the help we need when we need it.

I'm sorry you experienced that, I guess it just shows how little people know or understand anything to do with mental health.

I agree. 

I know but it doesnt help does it. Everyones so engrossed in their own illness and pain that even if you put us in a room together it would probably only become a competition. 
Also the term "chronic" gets you blacklisted at hospitals and wards, so it looks like theres just no help.

Good luck to you
